info.title: Mediflow API: planned endpoints
info.description: Endpoints the web app is built against that the API does not implement yet. Hand-written. When the API implements one, delete it here: the generated spec then provides it.

post.description: Changes the signed-in user's password. Asks for the current password. Every other session of the user is ended; the one making the call stays signed in.

get.description: The signed-in user's own active sessions, newest first. A user has few, so there is one page.

delete.description: Ends one of the signed-in user's other sessions: that browser is signed out on its next request. The session making the call cannot be ended here (use sign-out).

post.description: Opens a deep link to a record by its globally unique id. The server finds the hospital that owns the record, checks that the user is an active member of it, and rebinds the session to that hospital if another one (or none) is active. Every refusal is the same 403 link_unavailable, whether the record does not exist or belongs to a hospital the user does not work at, so a link cannot be used to find out what exists.

kind.description: The kind of record, e.g. notice.

200.description: The session, bound to the hospital that owns the record

get.description: Staff notices of the active tenant, newest first. Sample feature (F-13). Requires notice:read and the notices feature flag.

post.description: Archives a notice so it no longer appears in the list. Requires notice:manage.

get.description: Today's tokens at the hospital (its own calendar day, worked out by the server), in call order: the priority ones first, then by the time they were issued. With `doctorId`, the doctor's queue: the tokens issued for that doctor and the tokens of the doctor's department issued for no doctor, which is what call-next takes from. Requires queue:read and the queue feature flag. Names patients, so every page read is audited.

post.description: Issues today's next token of a department to a patient, optionally for one doctor of that department. The number is given by the server, one sequence per department per day, safe when two desks issue at once. A patient with a token still waiting, called or skipped in that department today is refused (409 `already_queued`). Requires queue:create and patient:read (a role that may not read patients learns nothing about one here: an unknown patient and a patient it may not read are both 422 `unknown_patient`). Emits `queue.token_issued`.

parameters.name: idempotency-key
parameters.description: A unique value (such as a UUID) chosen by the client, required: a request without one is refused (400). Repeating the request with the same key returns the first result instead of doing the work again; the same key with a different request is refused (422 `idempotency_key_reuse`).

post.description: Calls the next token of a doctor's queue (see listQueueTokens) and gives it to the doctor; the token the doctor was serving becomes `served`. Nobody waiting is 409 `queue_empty`. Requires queue:call. Emits `queue.called`.

parameters.name: idempotency-key
parameters.description: A unique value (such as a UUID) chosen by the client, required: a request without one is refused (400). Repeating the request with the same key returns the first result instead of doing the work again; the same key with a different request is refused (422 `idempotency_key_reuse`).

post.description: Calls the token being served again, when the patient has not come in. Only a `called` token (409 `invalid_transition` otherwise). Requires queue:call. Emits `queue.called`.

parameters.name: idempotency-key
parameters.description: A unique value (such as a UUID) chosen by the client, required: a request without one is refused (400). Repeating the request with the same key returns the first result instead of doing the work again; the same key with a different request is refused (422 `idempotency_key_reuse`).

200.description: The token as it is now

post.description: The patient called did not come: the token is put aside as `skipped`. Only a `called` token. Requires queue:call.

parameters.name: idempotency-key
parameters.description: A unique value (such as a UUID) chosen by the client, required: a request without one is refused (400). Repeating the request with the same key returns the first result instead of doing the work again; the same key with a different request is refused (422 `idempotency_key_reuse`).

200.description: The token as it is now

post.description: A skipped patient has come back: the token waits again, at the place its priority and the time it was issued give it. Only a `skipped` token. Requires queue:call.

parameters.name: idempotency-key
parameters.description: A unique value (such as a UUID) chosen by the client, required: a request without one is refused (400). Repeating the request with the same key returns the first result instead of doing the work again; the same key with a different request is refused (422 `idempotency_key_reuse`).

200.description: The token as it is now

post.description: Sets or clears the reason a token goes ahead of the others (null clears it). Only a `waiting` or `skipped` token. Requires queue:call.

parameters.name: idempotency-key
parameters.description: A unique value (such as a UUID) chosen by the client, required: a request without one is refused (400). Repeating the request with the same key returns the first result instead of doing the work again; the same key with a different request is refused (422 `idempotency_key_reuse`).

200.description: The token as it is now

get.description: Server-sent events for the queues of the session's hospital, and of no other. Each `queue` event says only which department's queue changed (`data: {"departmentId":"..."}`), never who: the screen then reads the queue again through listQueueTokens, which is audited. A comment line is sent every 20 seconds to keep the connection open; a client takes 45 seconds without anything as a lost connection. The server ends the stream when the session ends, is revoked or switches hospital, and when the session loses queue:read or the hospital the queue switch, and checks the session again before each event. Requires queue:read and the queue feature flag.

200.description: An event stream that stays open

get.description: The patient's readings, newest first, corrections and the readings they correct included. Optionally only those taken for one queue token. Requires vitals:read and the triage feature flag. Audited in the request's transaction.

post.description: Records a reading, audited in the request's transaction, and emits vitals.recorded through the outbox (tenantId, the reading's id, patientId, queueTokenId when given, the actor and the time). The token must be this patient's and today's, in any status (a re-check after the consultation is allowed); otherwise 422 `token_not_for_patient`. A correction names a reading of this patient that no other reading corrects yet (422 `unknown_correction`, 422 `already_corrected`), and takes that reading's queueTokenId and encounterId: a queueTokenId sent with a correction is refused (400). A patient the hospital does not have is 404. The idempotency key is kept per hospital and user. Requires vitals:record and the triage feature flag.

parameters.name: idempotency-key
parameters.description: A unique value (such as a UUID) chosen by the client, required: a request without one is refused (400). Repeating the request with the same key returns the first result instead of doing the work again; the same key with a different request is refused (422 `idempotency_key_reuse`).

get.description: One reading of the patient. Requires vitals:read and the triage feature flag. Audited.

The hospital's normal ranges that apply to this patient, decided by the server from the patient's age at the hospital's date. Audited, as it tells whether the patient is under 18. Requires vitals:read and the triage feature flag.
The patient's allergies; status `unknown` and version 0 while never recorded. Requires allergy:read and the triage feature flag. Audited.

put.description: Replaces the patient's allergies from the version the edit started from; another change first is 409 `conflict`. Requires allergy:update and the triage feature flag. Audited in the request's transaction, and emits allergy.updated through the outbox (tenantId, patientId, the new version, the actor and the time; never the allergies themselves).

200.description: The allergies as they are now

NoticePage.description: Cursor envelope used by every list endpoint.

userAgent.description: The browser as it described itself at sign-in, for the person to recognise the device.

current.description: True for the session making this call.

QueueTokenStatus.description: waiting -> called -> served, called -> skipped (did not come), skipped -> waiting (came back). A doctor calling the next token makes the one they were serving `served`.

QueuePriority.description: Why a token goes ahead of the others.

doctorId.description: A practising doctor of the department (422 `doctor_not_in_department` otherwise).

number.description: The department's number for the day.

day.description: The calendar day at the hospital.

doctorId.description: Absent while any doctor of the department may call it.

calledAt.description: The last time it was called.

Vitals.description: One reading of vital signs, append-only: a correction is a new reading that names the one it corrects. Attached to the patient and, when taken at the queue, to the token; encounterId is set once the OPD encounter exists (M7).

queueTokenId.description: The token the reading was taken for. A correction carries the one of the reading it corrects.

encounterId.description: Set once, from empty to the encounter, by the triage module itself when it hears encounter.opened for the reading's queue token (idempotently); nothing else of a reading ever changes. A reading taken outside the queue gets none until the API attaches readings to the patient's open encounter (M7).

temperature.description: Degrees Celsius, at most one decimal.

chiefComplaint.description: Plain text: what brings the patient today, in their words.

correctsId.description: The reading of the same patient this one corrects. The original is kept.

correctionReason.description: Plain text. Required with correctsId, refused without it.

VitalsCreate.description: At least one measurement or a chief complaint. Systolic and diastolic go together, the diastolic below the systolic.

queueTokenId.description: Today's token of this patient the reading was taken for. Not sent with a correction, which takes the corrected reading's.

temperature.description: Degrees Celsius, at most one decimal.

chiefComplaint.description: Plain text: what brings the patient today, in their words.

correctsId.description: The reading of the same patient this one corrects. The original is kept.

correctionReason.description: Plain text. Required with correctsId, refused without it.

VitalRange.description: Values below low or above high are abnormal. A limit that is absent is not checked.

ranges.description: The hospital's ranges that apply to this patient, or null when none do (a patient under 18: ranges are for adults until #379).

AllergyStatus.description: `unknown`: never asked. `none`: asked, no known allergies. `listed`: the items. Never asked and none are not the same.
